title: 🎃 Costume Exchange
description: Drop off gently used costumes from previous years, and pick up a new-to-you favorite completely for free!
details: Drop-off: Sundays or Monday evenings, Oct 4-12

title: 🎃 Costume DIY
description: Combine your new-to-you costume with your own custom accessories
details: Unleash your creativity to make masks, headbands, capes, accessories, etc
Help needed at the event to help others with gluing, sewing, cutting, designing

title: 🕵️‍♂️ Scavenger Hunt
description: Navigate through 3 to 4 themed rooms to solve riddles, collect clues, and win treats.
details: Rooms: Carnival, Mad Lab, Spooky Forest
Help Needed for character roles and decorating

title: 💃 Just Dance Dance-Along
description: Follow the moves on the big screen! High-energy dance tracking for kids and parents alike.

title: 📸 Photo Ops
description: Professional-grade backdrop rooms staged for the perfect family photo. Bring your own phone or camera!
details: Help needed for set-up and clean-up
